desc: Derive and verify closed-form count C(a, b, k) of (l, r) pairs with length ≤ k (case a+b-1 ≤ k → a*b; else piecewise arithmetic series), validated against brute-force enumeration of small (a, b, k).

Fix `count_pairs` with corrected cases (k < a → k(k+1)/2; a ≤ k < b → a·k − a(a−1)/2; a ≤ b ≤ k < a+b−1 → (k−b+1)b + b(b−1)/2 − (k−a)(k−a+1)/2) and validate helper against brute-force enumeration for all small (a, b, k) tuples.
Confirm monotonic-stack tie-breaking (strict left, non-strict right for min; mirrored for max) partitions subarrays correctly, including duplicates.
Test full solution against O(n²) brute force on random small arrays plus both given examples, covering k=1, k=n, duplicates, and negatives.
Write final `Solution.minMaxSubarraySum` (O(n) time, O(n) space) with brief comments; confirm constraints (n ≤ 80000, values ±10⁶) are handled.
